intro.what: Crab-like juvenile Destoroyahs crawl up out of the smoking ground by the waterfront in daylight, 0:59:36.

loop.what: SDF tanks and trucks draw up in a field below an elevated expressway to face the aggregates, one calm shot, 0:59:13.

kill.what: A juvenile Destoroyah beside a building is hit by the SDF freezer beam and bursts in blue light, sparks and smoke, 1:01:44.

escape.what: A juvenile Destoroyah, struck by sparks, rears up and lunges toward a yellow SDF vehicle in the foreground, 1:00:37.

wave.what: A glittering red swarm of aggregates converges and the giant aggregate form of Destoroyah takes shape out of it, 1:09:11.

boss.what: The perfect form of Destoroyah in close-up, eye glowing and jaws open, roars through blue mist, 1:24:07.

won.what: Destoroyah crashes down in a burst of sparks and lies sprawled on the ground, wings crumpled, 1:32:20.

lost.what: A run of shots: Destoroyah's purple micro-oxygen beam strikes Godzilla in a shower of sparks and he disappears in a fiery explosion, 1:20:54.

music.what: Ifukube's pounding brass battle music as the flying form of Destoroyah attacks the city and crowds flee, 1:06:42.

kill.what: A sharp explosion bursts against a juvenile Destoroyah in the night street, 0:38:42.

escape.what: A juvenile Destoroyah shrieks in close-up, horns crackling with lightning, as it turns on the riot police, 0:35:11.

wave.what: Destoroyah roars in close-up at the airport, a harsh rasping cry, 1:21:35.

boss.what: The perfect form of Destoroyah screeches in close-up with its jaws wide open, 1:24:44.

won.what: A huge explosion engulfs Destoroyah as Godzilla's ray strikes it, 1:33:27.

lost.what: Godzilla cries out in pain, glowing and staggering, after Destoroyah's beam hits him, 1:21:29.
